task.description: New work: a self-contained assignment. An existing window: only what changed or comes next, since it already holds its assignment and history. With answer_to: the answer.

task_id.description: new for new work, or an existing window's task_id to continue its work.

profile.description: Only with new, to use a named profile: its ID from `browser.windows`. Omit it for the default profile.

tab.description: Only with an existing window: a tab ID from `browser.windows` to work in.

url.description: Only an address <!-- personal-only:start -->the user<!-- personal-only:end --><!-- group-only:start -->a member<!-- group-only:end --> gave, one from a tool result such as a search result, or a well-known site whose address you are sure of. Never build one from a business or product name; omit it and name the business and its location in task.

answer_to.description: Only to answer a browser question of an existing window: the question_id from that question. A call without answer_to is an update for the browser planner.
